title.value: Guiding Language Model Math Reasoning with Planning Tokens
title.justification: The title was taken directly from the header of the paper.
title.quote: Guiding Language Model Math Reasoning with Planning Tokens

extractions.description: The paper introduces a method for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by using planning tokens to guide chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. This approach involves adding special tokens at the start of each reasoning step, which help maintain coherence across the reasoning process. The technique is applied through full fine-tuning or parameter-efficient schemes to enhance LLMs' performance on complex math word problems.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving the mathematical reasoning capabilities of language models, which does not directly relate to climate or ecological sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have recently attracted considerable interest for their ability to perform complex reasoning tasks, such as chain-ofthought reasoning. However, most of the existing approaches to enhance this ability rely heavily on data-driven methods, while neglecting the structural aspects of the model’s reasoning capacity.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not discuss topics related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
primary_category.quote: We do not foresee a significant societal impact resulting from our proposed method. In this work, we propose to equip LLMs with planning tokens to obtain better reasoning capabilities.

primary_sub_category.justification: No sub-category related to Ecological or Climate Sustainable Development is addressed in the paper.
primary_sub_category.quote: Our approach requires a negligible increase in trainable parameters (just 0.001%) and can be applied through either full fine-tuning or a more parameter-efficient scheme.

new_primary_category.justification: The focus of the paper is on improving the reasoning capabilities of language models without any direct link to climate or ecological sustainability categories.
new_primary_category.quote: Our planning tokens increase the performance over baselines at a minimal parameter cost.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not address new applications or sub-categories within the realm of Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We propose to strategically add new tokens into CoTs at training time. More specifically, we introduce planning tokens at the beginning of each CoT step, which are special tokens that encode a high-level solution plan.
